Important Dates & Deadlines

Important Dates & Deadlines

Start of Quarter
Date Event
Wed, Sep 23 First Day of Classes
Registration
Date Event
Tue, May 12 - Mon, Jul 13 Phase I - registration for continuing students - students can register for up to 18 credits max
Tue, Jul 14 - Mon, Aug 24 Registration Closed for Continuing Students
Tue, Jul 21 - Mon, Jul 27 Advising & Registration - Transfer Students
Tue, Jul 21 - Thu, Jul 23 Advising & Registration - Post-Baccalaureate
Tue, Jul 28 - Thu, Jul 30 Advising & Registration - First-Year Students (45+ Incoming Credits)
Mon, Aug 3 - Wed, Aug 19 Advising & Registration - First-Year Students (Less Than 45 Incoming Credits)
Tue, Aug 25 - Tue, Sep 22 Phase II - registration for continuing, new transfer, and post-baccalaureate students - students can register for up to 20 credits max
Thu, Sep 10 Advising & Registration - First-Year Students (unable to attend in August)
Tue, Sep 22 Advising & Registration - First-Year Students (unable to attend in August)
Wed, Sep 23 - Tue, Sep 29 Phase III - open registration - students can register for up to 20 credits max - waitlisting hours change from 24 to 12 hours
Last Day Deadlines
Date Event
Fri, May 1 Priority date for readmission after being away one quarter or longer other than summer quarter
Fri, Jun 5 Last day to apply for a bachelor's degree (before late fee applies)
Mon, Sep 21 Last day to apply for graduate degree
Wed, Sep 23 Tuition and fees, housing and meal plan charges due
Tue, Sep 29 Waitlisting ends at 11:59 p.m.
Tue, Sep 29 Last day to withdraw from WWU or drop a class with full refund (ends at 11:59 p.m.)
Tue, Sep 29 Last day to change to-or-from Audit
Tue, Sep 29 Last day to add a class without an override
Sun, Oct 4 Last day to drop a class without incurring a "W" grade on official transcript ("XM" code appears on unofficial academic history only)
Sun, Oct 4 Last day to add or drop a class without incurring a $10 per credit late fee
Thu, Oct 15 Last day to pay account before late payment charges are assessed
Sun, Oct 18 Last day to change to-or-from Pass/No Pass
Thu, Oct 22 Last day for half-tuition refund when dropping a class (fees are not refunded)
Fri, Oct 30 Last day to apply for a Bachelor's degree (late fees apply)
Sun, Nov 8 Last day to withdraw from a class. Online registration via Web4U ends at 11:59 p.m.
Sun, Nov 8 Last day to make a reservation for December Commencement
Sun, Nov 29 Last day to withdraw from WWU - for fall quarter only
End of Quarter
Date Event
Mon, Dec 7 - Fri, Dec 11 Final Exams
Sat, Dec 12 December Commencement
Holidays
Date Event
Mon, Sep 7 Labor Day
Wed, Nov 11 Veterans Day
Wed, Nov 25 - Sun, Nov 29 Thanksgiving Break (Wed, Nov 25 - University open, no classes)
Fri, Nov 27 Native American Heritage Day
Sat, Dec 12 - Mon, Jan 4 Winter Break
